description: This PHP source file defines the class 'SchedulerMigrationResult', which encapsulates the outcome of a scheduler migration operation within SuiteCRM. The class includes properties to track success status, actions taken, messages, counts of schedulers found and updated, and additional details. It provides static methods to generate different result types (skip, success, error) and utility methods to query the migration status.
external_files: not explicitly referenced external files within the code — it primarily depends on PHP core and runtime environment

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a scheduler migration operation, including success status, messages, counts, and details, with static methods for creating specific result instances.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with success status, action, message, counts, and optional details.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Creates a successful skip result, indicating no schedulers were found to migrate.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a successful migration result, indicating schedulers have been found and updated, optionally as a dry run.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates an error result with a message and optional exception details.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Returns true if the migration was successful.

methods.name: hasSchedulers
methods.description: Returns true if any schedulers were found.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Returns true if this result pertains to a dry run.

methods.name: wasSkipped
methods.description: Returns true if the migration was skipped.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation summarizing the migration result.
